target_source_rule: The equivalence margin and any minimum meaningful routing contrast must be prospectively justified by biological relevance, assay calibration, theory, or independent prior information. Stage-0 positional effect estimates must not be used to choose a convenient margin; Stage-0 supplies nuisance parameters only and target justification must be independent of the focal positional contrast.

primary_estimand.name: delta_route_log_odds
primary_estimand.definition: logit(P(transfer_fate | abaxial source)) - logit(P(transfer_fate | median source))
primary_estimand.transfer_fate: source-resolved pollen assigned to a preregistered transfer-associated visitor-body sector or deposited on a conspecific stigma
primary_estimand.reward_fate: source-resolved pollen assigned to preregistered groomable/collected sectors
primary_estimand.unresolved_or_lost_fate: tracked separately; never silently recoded as transfer or reward

precision_stopping_rule.final_scale_rule: Choose a design that reaches the registered target power for the minimum meaningful outside-band contrast and adequate precision to place a truly equivalent contrast inside the same band across the frozen nuisance sensitivity range.

fail_closed_rules: Do not run final power while any REQUIRED_BEFORE_USE field remains.
Do not use the Stage-0 median-versus-abaxial effect estimate to set the equivalence margin.
Do not set plant-level ICC to zero merely because the Stage-0 estimate is unstable; use a frozen sensitivity range.
Do not call SHARED_INTEGRATED from P > 0.05; the full confidence interval must lie inside the frozen equivalence band.
Do not call WITHIN_FLOWER_DIVISION_OF_LABOUR if a positional effect can be explained solely by unequal available pollen without controlling or modelling that quantity.
Do not treat pollen grains from the same flower, visit, bee or plant as independent biological replicates.
